scientific_integrity: The continuous error operator, its boundary-value spectral reduction, the leading eigenfunction, the sharp relaxation interval, and the minimax parameter were reconstructed analytically. The 2012 primary article was inspected in full through authorized access; later fixed-point acceleration, regularized-sweep, and discretized iterative-solver literature was compared for implication coverage.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the continuous scalar linear–quadratic problem and the explicitly defined constant-relaxation update. No claim is made about a finite time discretization or undocumented implementation details. The originality search cannot exclude unindexed notes or theses.
title: Exact relaxation resonance in a classical forward–backward sweep counterexample
